description: Search Free Discovery catalogs and return an interactive research widget (MCP App). Results contain article metadata only, without the full article body. Counts against the monthly Free Discovery search quota.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response next_cursor.

filters.description: Optional metadata filters. Fields: category, categories, language, sentiment, media_type, has_image, has_video, has_audio, length_words, length_chars, duration_seconds, publish_date_ts, keywords, entities. Operators: $eq, $ne, $gt, $gte, $lt, $lte, $in, $nin, $exists, $and, $or. Example: {"category": "sports", "has_image": true}.

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return. Default: 10. Results are ordered by closest match first (lowest cosine distance).

publishers.description: Optional array of lowercase publisher identifiers to narrow the search (e.g. adweek, billboard). Omit to search all publishers available on Free Discovery.

query.description: Semantic search query to find relevant articles. Supports natural language queries (e.g., 'Taylor Swift', 'NFL playoffs', 'climate change policy')

query_vector.description: Optional precomputed embedding vector. If provided, retrieval uses this vector directly instead of generating one from query.

recent.description: Recent mode: {since_ts: epoch seconds, take: int} or {days_back: int, take: int}. If both are provided, since_ts takes precedence.

threshold.description: Cosine distance cutoff. Keep results with distance less than or equal to this value (lower distance = closer match). Lower values = stricter (fewer results). Default: 1.0 (returns most matches).

name: search_ui
title: Search with research UI
